rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: val_n=200, val_chunk=5, train_n=400, epochs=10, batch_size=1, lr=0.005, tv_K=10, tv_step_init=0.001, tv_lambda_init=0.05, tv_share_steps=False, tv_eps=1e-06, lambda_neg=1.0, loss_base=mse, grad_clip=1.0, rationale=tv_iterative_supervised iter-8 (breast_ct). LAMBDA-INIT edge probe. iters 1-7 confirm the FBP-init MSE attractor across step/depth/loss/sharing/outer-lr -- step[k] always ->0, recon=FBP, hr0. lambda has been pinned at 1e-3 (inert once step->0). This iter tests the lambda edge: init a STRONG TV prior (lambda_init=0.05, 50x) so the TV gradient term is large FROM THE START -- IF the recon takes even a few non-zero steps early (before step collapses) a strong TV could denoise the FBP streaks materially. ONE KNOB: tv_lambda_init 1e-3->0.05 (step_init=1e-3, K=10, mse, per-iter, lr=5e-3 -- iter-3 base). FALSIFIER: if step still ->0 first, lambda never gets to act (product step*lambda*tv_grad ->0) and hr stays 0 -> confirms step-collapse gates lambda entirely. This closes the lambda edge of the search box. BUDGET: K=10 mse ~750s, <1200s wall.
